Most smart home lighting solutions rely on small bulbs and plug-in adapters, but as the market matures, we're beginning to see recessed ceiling fixtures with native Apple Home support via Matter. SwitchBot has just launched its new SwitchBot RGBICWW Ceiling Light, which offers out-of-the-box native Matter support along with high-brightness output.

HomeKit Weekly is a series focused on smart home accessories, automation tips, and everything related to Apple's smart home framework.

Native Matter and Apple Home Integration

The biggest selling point of this new ceiling light is that it requires no SwitchBot Hub at all and supports Matter straight out of the box. As long as your Apple TV 4K or HomePod at home stays connected, the fixture can join your existing smart home system directly over a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.

Size and Brightness Specifications

SwitchBot offers two sizes to suit different scenarios: the 12-inch model targets hallways and bathrooms, providing 2,000 lumens of brightness; the larger 15-inch model is suited to living rooms and bedrooms, reaching up to 3,200 lumens. It also supports stepless dimming, smoothly adjusting from 100% all the way down to 0%.

Typical smart bulbs can usually only display one colour at a time, but this fixture uses RGBIC technology, which employs independent chips to simultaneously render multiple colours on the ceiling, creating dynamic lighting effects. If you prefer more traditional lighting, it also comes with dedicated warm-white and cool-white LEDs, with colour temperatures adjustable from 2700K to 6500K. Additionally, it features a power-off memory function — meaning even after a brief power outage, the fixture will retain your previously set brightness and colour. Summary: SwitchBot RGBICWW

Using 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi means you'll need to permanently add another device running on the traditional band to your router. In my view, if it could have a built-in Thread radio with mesh networking for near-instant response times, the experience would be even better. Being able to buy a hardwired, native-Matter ceiling light for under $50 is an extremely cost-effective option for anyone looking to permanently upgrade their ceiling fixtures.

You can purchase this new SwitchBot RGBICWW on Amazon right now.
